_comment: Khắc Văn (spec 12.2): carve a learned word (mastery >= mastery_min) on a piece of equipment by answering `questions` questions about it in a row (one wrong answer ends the try, the fee is spent when it starts). Slots by rarity. The stat comes from by_hanzi (spec examples: 火 attack, 山 defence, 水 resistance (the game has no slowing of players, so 水 gives Kháng Mực), 心 Linh Lực) or else from the word's Thủ Vườn role (plants/plant_roles.json), times rarity_mult of the piece. erase_fee: Linh Thạch to scrape one character off.
